NSCameraUsageDescription: The camera is used to scan parcel barcodes and to photograph proof of delivery or a cheque. No image is sent without your action.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Pick an existing photo as proof of delivery, a cheque image, or a claim attachment.
NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Your location is recorded with a delivery, to prove where it happened. It is never read in the background, and the app works if you refuse.
NSFaceIDUsageDescription: The biometric lock protects your run and your statements if the phone changes hands. It is optional and can be turned off under Profile.
